questions.question: While the temple was being repaired in King Josiah's day, what did High Priest Hilkiah say he had found?
When King Josiah heard the words of the Book of the Law read to him, he tore his clothes. True or false?
King Josiah sent men to ask the LORD about the newly found Book of the Law. Which prophetess did they go to?
Through the prophetess Huldah, the LORD told King Josiah calamity was coming on the people. What reason did He give?

answers.text: They forsook Him for other gods
They let His temple fall apart
They lost the Book of the Law
